Frequently Asked Questions

Is NUMS better than RMU?

Both National University of Medical Sciences and Rawalpindi Medical University are HEC-recognized universities. NUMS is private (est. 2015) in Rawalpindi, while RMU is public (est. 1974) in Rawalpindi. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between NUMS and RMU?

NUMS's fee is approximately Rs. 60–120K/sem per semester, while RMU's is Rs. 50–80K/sem. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for NUMS and RMU?

NUMS: Army/NUMS Merit List. RMU: 80%+ aggregate (MDCAT).
